system.description:
• Effect: Once per day, when you use Marked Prey, for the encounter your marked prey has Disadvantage on Hide checks against you, can't Disengage from you, and you know where it is while it's within 60ft; a creature that turns invisible stays marked.
  • 24th level: you may use Apex Predator twice per day, and you have Advantage on checks to track, corner or finish your marked prey

activities.name: Apex Predator
activities.text: When you use Marked Prey: for the encounter your marked prey has Disadvantage on Hide checks against you, can't Disengage from you, and you know where it is within 60ft; turning invisible doesn't end the mark. From 24th level you may use it twice per day, with Advantage on checks to track, corner or finish your marked prey.
